scope: Widen open-source DWG/DXF 3D research from entity/version inventories to operation-route capability, parser/kernel lineage, exact ACIS/ASM carrier handling, and ODA specification-version delta admission.

method.kind: Primary project documentation/source, release pages, maintainer issue, and local plan reconciliation
method.evidenceBoundary: Project documentation, source, release notes, and maintainer reports establish published route/capability boundaries only. No source build or runtime comparison was made. GDAL raw carrier output is not solid geometry; ezdxf partial ACIS parsing is not arbitrary-body support; InventorLoader parser and FreeCAD Part kernel are distinct lineage layers; FreeCAD stock import is a different route. Mutable main-source observations are discovery leads and the peer-hosted ODA 5.4.2 delta is not byte-layout authority; repository instructions continue to make the local ODA 5.4.1 specification authoritative.

evidence.topic: DWG specification version and peer delta
observed: Repository instructions designate ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 as the authoritative source for DWG byte layouts.
LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS refers to a peer-hosted fixed v5.4.2 specification diff.
The diff is useful to identify candidate spec-version discrepancies, but it is not the full official specification and was not compared clause-by-clause in this pass.
evidence.planUse: For version-sensitive parser/writer work, name the local v5.4.1 clause and inspect any relevant v5.4.2 delta as a diagnostic checklist; do not change byte layout without authoritative-spec or real-sample support.

evidence.topic: GDAL AC1027+ raw ASM carrier route
observed: The DXF driver skips 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, and SURFACE by default because it cannot translate ASM into OGR geometry.
DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE can expose ASMData and a 12-value affine ASMTransform for AutoCAD 2013 (AC1027) and later DXF.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS/ASM semantic decode or B-rep construction
DWG AcDs association or pre-AC1027 support
Acceptance of a particular libdxfrw output
evidence.planUse: Optional composed-check carrier/transform cross-check on a locally generated AC1027+ DXF only; keep it outside solid geometry and CAD support claims.

evidence.topic: ezdxf ACIS subset and projection boundary
observed: The documentation states that only a limited set of ACIS entities is supported and unsupported entities may load as NONE_ENTITY with data loss.
mesh_from_body uses flat polygonal Face entities; curved ACIS surfaces need a modeler kernel not supplied by ezdxf.
evidence.planUse: Use for targeted DXF/carrier and explicit unsupported-disposition checks; it is not a curved-surface geometry oracle or arbitrary ACIS preservation guarantee.

evidence.topic: InventorLoader parser versus FreeCAD kernel lineage
observed: The GPL-2 FreeCAD add-on publishes its own SAT/SAB parsing implementation and routes bodies into FreeCAD Part faces/wires or an optional STEP conversion path.
The project documents no SAT/SAB/DXF export and lists unsupported blending and helix cases.
The parser is a distinct route, but its geometry construction uses FreeCAD Part/kernel and therefore is not an independent kernel result or the stock DXF/DWG importer.
evidence.planUse: Retain only exact, narrow SAT/SAB witnesses; bind add-on revision, FreeCAD build, import strategy, omissions, and independent shape metrics. Record parser lineage separately from kernel and consumer route.

observed: FreeCAD documents a built-in C++ DXF route and optional legacy Python route; DWG processing uses an external converter.
A FreeCAD maintainer states in issue #18454 that the stock importer cannot read the proprietary ACIS blob.
doesNotEstablish: Every release/platform/entity behavior from mutable source or docs alone
Any converter handoff as proof of ACIS geometry acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep S8.9.5 as converter/importer handoff unless the exact final FreeCAD document contains independently expected geometry. Bind release, platform, converter, importer mode, preferences, and operation.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp released structural capability and freshness
observed: The signed v3.8.0 release is pinned at commit 3a1c66b and its release notes list an InternalsVisibleTo change only.
The v3.6.51 release notes include ACIS payload reading from DXF/DWG, AcDs payload-offset handling, and Prototype1b parsing.
The ACIS DXF writer PR #1240 and nested-solid loss issue #1195 are separate from what the released v3.8.0 artifact proves.
evidence.planUse: Use an exact release/source pin as an optional structural reader only; run modelspace and nested block/INSERT coverage separately and keep open PR or issue behavior non-promoting.

nextActions: Keep parser, exact carrier, projection, B-rep interpretation, and named native consumer as independent evidence layers.

Use locally generated controls only; at one composed checkpoint optionally compare a pinned GDAL raw-carrier route, ezdxf structural route, ACadSharp release, and/or InventorLoader exact SAT/SAB route.
When using InventorLoader, report its parser lineage separately from its FreeCAD Part/kernel and selected SAT-versus-STEP strategy.
Use the local ODA v5.4.1 PDF as byte-layout authority and consult peer-reported newer diffs only to identify a discrepancy for authoritative review.
Keep per-slice validation fast; run external peers and broad/native suites only at planned composed checkpoints.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
